description: Pinned proof extract for Revival 012. Augmented Strong identities are aligned through Open Scriptures Hebrew Lexicon AugIndex; compact lexical labels preserve Strong's public-domain lexical range without asserting passage-level sense or referent identity.

upstream.license: CC BY 4.0 for Open Scriptures project files; Strong's Hebrew Dictionary text is public domain

extraction_law.alignment: OSHB lemma morphemes are aligned to OSHB morphology morphemes before selecting the noun/verb lexical component. Prefix components are never silently stripped.
extraction_law.lexical_identity: The selected augmented Strong component must exactly equal an entry's augmented_strong value.
extraction_law.name_boundary: A lexeme name identifies a lexical entry, not the passage-level referent, theological sense, geographic place, person, object, or event.

entries.proof_note: Lexical range only; passage-level referent and sense remain separate questions.
Lexical range only; does not itself establish a geographic entity.
Lexical range only; does not itself establish cosmological interpretation.
Lexical range only; does not itself establish a discrete object identity.
Lexical range only; does not itself establish what physical or symbolic light is intended.
